title: AWS Certified Advanced Networking - Specialty (ANS-C01)
summary: AWS Certified Advanced Networking - Specialty (ANS-C01) is a specialty certification for practitioners who go deep on one AWS discipline. The exam is organised into 4 content domains: Network Design (30%), Network Implementation (26%), Network Management and Operation (20%), Network Security, Compliance, and Governance (24%). It is delivered as 50 scored questions and 15 unscored, scored against a scaled pass mark of 750 out of 1,000 with no per-domain minimum, so strength in one domain offsets weakness in another. Every task statement in this topic carries a MEDIUM and a HARD exercise batch, so the practice material follows the published outline of the exam rather than a general reading list. The statements here are taken from the exam guide, and the task list is the one AWS publishes: if AWS revises the guide, this topic is revised with it.
objectives: Network Design: the guide's domain 1 focus, examined through its 6 task statement(s).
Network Implementation: the guide's domain 2 focus, examined through its 4 task statement(s).
Network Management and Operation: the guide's domain 3 focus, examined through its 3 task statement(s).
Network Security, Compliance, and Governance: the guide's domain 4 focus, examined through its 3 task statement(s).
